jobs.title: Rare Cardiac Access Care Manager Central California
jobs.description:
ROLE SUMMARY


As part of Pfizer Specialty Care, this individual will report to the Regional Director, Patient Access \& Reimbursement. The Access Care Manager (ACM) serves as a field\-based access leader responsible for integrating patient journey ownership, reimbursement expertise, and account\-level strategy to ensure appropriate patient access. This role combines high\-touch patient engagement with advanced subject matter expertise in reimbursement, payer policy, and coverage strategy, acting as a trusted partner to healthcare providers and internal stakeholders.


ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES


Patient Journey Leadership \& Case Management

* Serve as the primary point of contact for consented patients across the treatment journey from enrollment through therapy initiation and continuation.
* Conduct patient needs assessments addressing coverage, affordability, and logistical barriers to access for consented patients.
* Assist in coordinating care across healthcare providers, caregivers, and sites of care to ensure continuity and timely progression to therapy for consented patients.
* Maintain accountability for end\-to\-end patient progression, ensuring proactive identification and resolution of barriers.


Reimbursement Subject Matter Expertise

* Act as a field\-based expert on reimbursement, coverage pathways, and payer policy impacting Pfizer therapies.
* Provide guidance on the prior authorization process, step edits, coding, and payer\-specific requirements.
* Support the resolution of reimbursement challenges through appropriate escalation and coordination.


HCP Education \& Training

* Deliver compliant education on reimbursement processes, coverage pathways, and patient access resources, including .
* hub services, enrollment processes, and financial assistance programs to improve access efficiency.


Account\-Level Strategy \& System Optimization

* Develop and execute account\-level access strategies to improve patient access at scale.
* Identify systemic barriers and implement solutions to optimize workflows and assist in reducing delays in therapy initiation.


Payer Interaction \& Access Resolution

* Engage with payer organizations, as appropriate, to clarify coverage policies and support resolution of access challenges.
* Facilitate communication between HCP offices, payers, and patient support programs to ensure efficient navigation of the reimbursement process.


Internal Strategic Influence \& Market Insights

* Provide actionable insights on payer trends, reimbursement challenges, and access barriers to internal stakeholders.
* Support development of cross\-functional strategies by translating field insights into recommendations.
* High degree of Business Acumen and deep understanding of market dynamics and drivers in the Access space and accounts.


Cross\-Functional \& Commercial Alignment

* Collaborate with Sales, Key Account Managers, Marketing, and Patient Solutions teams to ensure aligned execution of access strategies.
* Participate in account planning and contribute to coordinated, patient\-centric approaches to access.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**


Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

* 8\+ years of pharmaceutical (or related) experience in customer\-facing roles/functions, 9 with Masters, BSN or Rph
* 1\+ years in Access and Reimbursement support role
* Minimum 3–5 years of Specialty Pharma experience, preferably within the Pharmaceutical/ Biopharmaceutical sectors, Provider/Carrier Networks, or Government Agency. Reimbursement and Access experience is a must and experience in the Cardiology sector is preferred. Strong understanding of Reimbursement, Government Payment Systems, Provider/Carrier Networks, Co\-Pay Assistance Programs, and knowledge of the Specialty policy dynamics that exist in the Rare Disease Community.
* Experience demonstrating exceptional communication and presentation skills, strategic planning and success in implementation of plans. This individual must also have demonstrated leadership and success at working across internal boundaries and be able to collaborate with multiple stakeholders to coordinate various unique objectives.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a highly regulated environment and adhere to strict company compliance guidelines and procedures. Proven track record of collaborating broadly with a diverse range of customers, clients, and stakeholders. Training in and experience in responsible business communication both written and spoken.
* Valid US driver’s license and driving record in compliance with company standards. Any DUI/DWI or other impaired driving citation within the past 7 years will disqualify you from being hired.

**NON\-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS**


Operate a Pfizer company car and regularly travel by air to attend external meetings and meetings or conferences. Travel to HCP offices as needed. Travel is expected to be approximately 30% of the time with overnight travel required. Must live within the geography, or within 25 miles or closer to territory boundaries.

**OTHER JOB DETAILS**


Last day to apply: August 2, 2026  

Territory : CA \- lives in Central or Northern California


The annual base salary for this position ranges from $139,100\.00 to $231,900\.00\. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 17\.5% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Co

jobs.title: Housing Navigator Lead
jobs.description:
#### **Position: Community Supports (CS) Housing Navigation Lead**


Classification: Part\-Time, non\-exempt



Supervised by: Senior Manager, Housing Programs



Home Start’s vision is for every child to have a safe, stable, and nurturing home. Guided by our mission to assure the safety and resiliency of children by strengthening families and their communities, Home Start, Inc., a non\-profit child abuse prevention, and treatment agency has strengthened and developed San Diego’s families and communities since 1972\.


#### **Job Summary:**


Provides leadership, clinical and administrative oversight to Community Supports Housing Navigators. Ensures quality service delivery, staff development, regulatory compliance, contract performance, and collaboration with Managed Care Plans and community partners.


#### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Supervise, coach, and evaluate Housing Navigators.
* Provide regular case consultation and guidance on complex member situations.
* Monitor productivity, documentation quality, and program outcomes.
* Ensure compliance with MediCal, contract, and organizational requirements.
* Facilitate team meetings, onboarding, and ongoing training.
* Attend required monthly supervisor meetings, partner meetings, and case consultations.
* Build and maintain collaborative partnerships with Managed Care Plans, landlords, and community providers while expanding resource and referral networks.
* Support quality improvement initiatives and reporting requirements.
* Assist with staffing, scheduling, and operational planning.

#### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred in a behavioral health or human services field.
* Three to five years of progressively responsible experience in housing, case management, or community services.
* Previous supervisory or lead experience required.
* Strong knowledge of MediCal Community Supports, housing resources, and documentation standards.
* Demonstrated leadership, coaching, and conflict resolution skills.

#### **Required Training \& Compliance**

#### **The below training will be provided upon hire:**

* Medicare Parts C and D General Compliance Training
* Dual Eligible Special Needs Plan (DSNP) Training
* Chronic Condition Special Needs Plan (CSNP) Training
* MediCal for Kids \& Teens Provider Training
* HIPAA Privacy \& Security Training
* Fraud, Waste and Abuse Training
* Cultural Competency Training
* Successfully complete all required background, registry, and exclusion screenings, including LEIE/OIG checks.


Home Start, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in the hiring of personnel because of gender, race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship pregnancy, age, marital status, sexual orientation, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or gender expression, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state or local laws.


#### **About HOME START INCORPORATED**


Guided by our mission to assure the safety and resiliency of children by strengthening families and their communities, Home Start, Inc., a non\-profit child abuse prevention and treatment agency, has strengthened and developed San Diego’s families, communities, and systems of care since 1972\. To effectively prevent and treat child abuse, Home Start addresses the conditions that can contribute to risky or abusive situations – poverty, unsafe neighborhoods, lack of affordable housing, and unemployment – while concurrently addressing individual self\-sufficiency and emotional needs.

#### **Position: Community Supports (CS) Housing Navigator**


Classification: Full\-Time, non\-exempt



Supervised by: CS Housing Supervisor



Home Start’s vision is for every child to have a safe, stable, and nurturing home. Guided by our mission to assure the safety and resiliency of children by strengthening families and their communities, Home Start, Inc., a non\-profit child abuse prevention, and treatment agency has strengthened and developed San Diego’s families and communities since 1972\.


#### **Job Summary:**


Provides Housing Transition Navigation, Housing Deposit, and Housing Tenancy and Sustaining Services to eligible Medi\-Cal members who are experiencing homelessness or are at risk of homelessness. Partners with members, landlords, health plans, and community providers to obtain and maintain safe, stable housing while ensuring documentation, service authorization, and regulatory compliance.


#### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Manage an active caseload of no less than 35 members.
* Complete member assessments and reassessments every six months or as required by the Managed Care Plan.
* Provide housing transition navigation, including housing search, applications, reasonable accommodation requests, and landlord engagement.
* Coordinate and facilitate housing deposits and onetime housingrelated financial assistance in accordance with program guidelines.
* Deliver tenancy sustaining services including landlord mediation, budgeting support, recertifications, and linkage to community resources.
* Assist members in obtaining benefits and other financial resources that support housing stability.
* Maintain accurate, timely documentation in required systems and complete all required tracking activities.
* Conduct internal and external outreach to build relationships and develop referral partnerships.
* Attend required monthly workshops, trainings, meetings, and case consultations.
* Maintain confidentiality and comply with all MediCal, HIPAA, and organizational requirements.

#### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Human Services, Psychology, or related field preferred. Relevant experience may substitute.
* Minimum two years of resource navigation experience is strongly preferred. Experience in case management, housing navigation, homeless services, or communitybased service delivery is also preferred.
* Knowledge of affordable housing resources, benefits systems, and traumainformed practices.
* Excellent communication, organization, and documentation skills.
* Valid California driver's license, reliable transportation, and insurability.

#### **Required Training and Compliance**


Training will be provided upon hire.


* Medicare Parts C \& D General Compliance Training
* Dual Eligible Special Needs Plan (DSNP) Training
* Chronic Condition Special Needs Plan (CSNP) Training
* MediCal for Kids \& Teens Provider Training

Our medical spa is at the forefront of merging medical advancements with beauty aesthetics, providing transformative skincare solutions to Hollywood’s elite. Our commitment to perfection is reflected in our innovative products that utilize scientifically proven ingredients to help clients achieve radiant, healthy skin.

**Summary**

As a Patient Care Coordinator, you will be an integral part of our team, ensuring that our clients receive exceptional care and support throughout their skincare journey. This role is vital in maintaining the high standards of service that define our brand and contribute to our mission of delivering innovative skincare solutions.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage patient scheduling and ensure efficient appointment flow.
* Collect and verify patient information while maintaining HIPAA compliance.
* Assist patients with inquiries regarding treatments and services offered.
* Coordinate communication between patients and healthcare providers to facilitate care.
* Maintain accurate health records and manage health information effectively.
* Support administrative tasks such as billing, collections, and office management.
* Utilize EMR software for scheduling and patient management tasks.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 1 year experience in Medical Spa, Dermatology or Plastic Surgery setting
* Proven experience in medical collection and health information management.
* Strong administrative skills with a focus on office management.
* Experience with medical scheduling processes and systems.
* Familiarity with Patient Now or similar EMR software is a plus.
* Excellent communication skills for effective patient interaction.
* Knowledge of HIPAA regulations to ensure patient confidentiality.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently in a fast\-paced environment.

If you are passionate about enhancing patient experiences in the beauty and healthcare industry, we invite you to apply today to join our dedicated team!

jobs.title: Kenwood Hearing Center Patient Care Coordinator / Office Administrator (E Cerrito)
jobs.description:
**Kenwood Hearing Centers Patient Care Coordinator/Office Administrator**

The Kenwood Hearing Centers Patient Care Coordinator/Office Administrator is the first point of contact for patients in our practice. This position is responsible for greeting patients, answering the phones, scheduling appointments, completing administrative processing and recordkeeping, and more. Each member of our team should be prepared to perform other assignments or duties as required.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

* Creates a warm, welcoming environment for patients and visitors
* Coordinates appointments and other actions such as invoice creation and payment collection utilizing office administration software
* Provides patient care on phone / in person – begins building a relationship and establishing trust, and maintains that over time through things like warm greetings, remembering customers and calling them by name, etc.
* Listens and responds to voicemails and emails from patients, prospects, and physicians
* Optimizes customer satisfaction, provider's time, and treatment room utilization
* Confirms hearing aids and ear molds are ready prior to client appointment
* Communicates to potential patients the value proposition of the practice and why patients should choose our practice over other competitive alternatives
* Manages payments / insurance claims and follow up for outstanding accounts
* Generates communication / mailings to patients and doctors
* Qualified to handle difficult situations / patients / vendors with a calm and pleasant demeanor
* Orders/processes hearing aid inventory/loaners/returns/shipping/receiving
* Basic hearing aid diagnostics/programming/clean/check as well as speaker replacement and Bluetooth pairing
* Orders/maintains office supplies and batteries

COMPETENCIES:

* Thoroughness and strong attention to detail, prioritization, and organization
* Excellent customer service and communication skills, in oral and written communication, in person, on the phone, and in emails
* Ability to create a very warm and friendly environment for patients and their companions – very strong people skills needed
* Willingness and ability to establish and continue new relationships with the medical community
* Natural empathy
* Ability to handle multiple tasks, troubleshoot and problem solve
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive information
* Strong people skills

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

* At least 3\-5 years of experience directly related to the duties and responsibilities specified, specifically with front desk responsibilities in a customer service\- and/or medically\-oriented environment
* Excellent communication skills and desire to develop and establish relationships with new people
* Must be high school graduate or above
* Excellent computer skills (Google Docs, Word, Excel, web\-based software)
* Ability to type at a reasonable WPM
* Proven ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and handle multiple tasks simultaneously
* Fluency in Spanish or other languages preferred

Education:

* High school or equivalent (Required)

Experience:

* Customer service: 3 years (Required)

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: From $30\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Transition Care Coordinator - PCC - Full Time/Days - Req #2117983517
jobs.description:
**Job Objective****:** The Transition Care Coordinator (TCC) is a vital resource responsible for managing both the physical discharge of patients and their preparation for a successful transition from hospital to home or other care settings. The TCC ensures that all discharge processes are completed accurately and efficiently, including verifying orders, resolving logistical challenges, and coordinating with the interdisciplinary team. This role also provides tailored education to patients and families on discharge instructions, medications, follow\-up care, and community resources. By addressing barriers such as incomplete orders, medication access, or transportation delays, the TCC ensures timely and safe discharges while empowering patients and families with the knowledge and resources needed to manage their health post\-discharge. The TCC operates independently, demonstrating initiative and adaptability in dynamic healthcare environments, improving patient outcomes, reducing readmissions, and enhancing satisfaction.

  


**Duties and Responsibilities:**

  


* **Patient Discharge Execution**


* Physically discharge patients by verifying that all orders are completed and ensuring the readiness of discharge medications and documentation.
* Collaborate with the bedside RN and Charge Nurse to help eliminate any identified barriers to a timely discharge.
* Coordinate with case managers, pharmacists, and nursing staff to address any last\-minute issues or barriers to discharge.
* Help resolve logistical challenges, such as arranging transportation or ensuring proper equipment is available for home use.
* Oversee the timely execution of all discharge\-related tasks to meet hospital benchmarks for efficiency.


* **Patient and Family Education**


* Provide detailed discharge education to patients and families, ensuring they understand instructions, medications, and follow\-up care.
* Develop and deliver educational materials tailored to patients' literacy levels and cultural needs.
* Proactively identify patients with upcoming discharges to initiate early education, reducing last\-minute confusion or delays.
* Conduct teaching sessions to address patient or family questions and concerns before discharge.


* **Collaboration and Communication**


* Serve as the primary liaison between patients, families, and the interdisciplinary care team during the discharge process.
* Communicate effectively with all team members to ensure a seamless transition of care, resolving any discrepancies in orders or processes.
* Ensure alignment between discharge plans and patient\-specific needs, coordinating additional services as required.


* **Process Optimization and Documentation**


* Maintain accurate and timely documentation of discharge processes and patient education in the electronic health record (EHR).
* Analyze discharge\-related data, such as length\-of\-stay metrics and readmission rates, to identify and address gaps in workflow or patient preparation.
* Propose and implement improvements to streamline discharge operations and enhance the patient experience.


* **Quality and Safety**


* Ensure compliance with hospital policies, accreditation standards, and evidence\-based practices related to discharge and education.
* Address potential safety risks, such as medication errors or inadequate follow\-up care plans, before discharge.
* Monitor and report trends in patient outcomes related to the discharge process and contribute to quality improvement initiatives.


* **Patient and Family Advocacy**


* Advocate for patient understanding and readiness by addressing barriers such as language, literacy, or access to resources.
* Work with social workers and community organizations to connect patients to external support systems.

  


**Non\-Essential Duties:**


* Participate in hospital\-wide educational initiatives related to patient discharge.
* Assist in training staff on effective patient education strategies.

  


**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

  

**Knowledge**


* Best practices in patient education and health literacy.
* Hospital discharge protocols and follow\-up care needs.
* Principles of adult learning and communication.

  



**Skills**


* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to engage patients and families.
* Strong organizational skills to manage multiple patients and educational initiatives.
* Proficiency in electronic health record systems for documentation.

**Abilities**


* Effectively teach and adapt content to meet diverse learning needs.
* Work independently while coordinating with interdisciplinary teams.
* Assess and respond to patient and family concerns with empathy and professionalism.

  


**AVMC Values: All AVMC employees will effectively demonstrate these values:**


* Patients Come First – We listen actively and communicate with our patients and families, placing safety as a top priority.
* Accountability \& Ownership – We fully complete tasks, are transparent, effectively communicate, and recognize that what we do reflects on us.
* Teamwork – We build trusting relationships, promote a sense of community, and are respectful of everyone. Success is about the whole team.
* Integrity \& Honesty – We tell the truth at all times, speak up when something is wrong, and do the right thing when no one is looking.
* Excellence – We take pride in our work, are goal\-oriented, and on a never\-ending quest for top tier quality.
* Initiative \& Innovation – Our can\-do attitudes, creativity, and resourcefulness empower us to improve the patient’s experience, solve our own problems, make timely decisions, and look for opportunities to add value.
* Tenderness \& Compassion – We have genuine empathy, show kindness, and encourage and advocate for each other.

**Education**

* Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) required.

  


**Experience**

* Minimum of 3 years of clinical nursing experience, preferably in discharge
